hub.legal: GRAVITAS is a free, fan-made companion for Elite Dangerous, made by Burak Servili (CMDR Hongark). It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Frontier Developments. It works only from what the game itself hands out: your Journal and status files, read on your own PC and never uploaded. It does not read the game's memory, change its files or hide anything. The map on gravitasmap.com shows public system data from Spansh. Elite Dangerous and Frontier are trademarks of Frontier Developments plc. Open source (MIT): github.com/Servly/gravitasmap
prof.note: Pick your ship from the list and save your window settings for it. GRAVITAS switches to them when you board that ship.
prof.save: Save my settings for this ship
prof.custom: Or a name of your own
menu.w.defpos.d: Put this window back as GRAVITAS starts it: place, colour, when it shows, perspective, size, opacity and order
menu.claims.bonds.d: The game lists bonds in its Claims panel. They are never lost, not even when your ship is destroyed.
menu.claims.note.d: The report counts only that fight. Claims hold every bounty you have not cashed in yet. When they differ, the report says how much comes from before the fight.
menu.th.rec: GRAVITAS shows what the game writes about a Thargoid fight: threat level, kills and bonds, attacks, shutdowns, heat and your hull steps. The game writes no Thargoid hull, shield or hearts, so none are shown. While Thargoids are about, GRAVITAS also records the fight on your computer (the status file and the Journal events that matter). It starts at the first Thargoid sign and stops ten minutes after the last. Nothing is sent anywhere.

mode.debrief.name: Debrief
mode.debrief.desc: The ship keys you press, and a report of each fight.
tip.nav.debrief: Debrief mode: see the ship keys you press and how each fight went.
page.debrief.sub: See which ship keys you press and how a fight went, then look back at it. Move the windows in Edit HUD.
db.privacy: Debrief follows only the keys the game's own Bindings file gives to ship actions, and only while the game is in front, you are in your ship and no panel or menu is open. Nothing you type is seen, and nothing leaves this computer.
db.mode.on.d: Shows the ship keys you press while you fly, and keeps a record of each fight on this computer. Off until you turn it on.
tip.db.on: Turn Debrief on or off. When on, the input window shows while you fly and each fight is recorded here.
db.rules.on.d: Adds up to three plain facts from the log to a report. Preview: off until you have checked them against your own fights.
tip.db.rules: Show the facts the log supports at the end of a report. They describe what happened together, never advice.
menu.db.wnote: The input window shows while you fly with Debrief on. The report shows for a while after each fight. Move them in Edit HUD.
db.binds.note: Read from the game's Bindings file. A key used with Shift, Ctrl or Alt, or a button only on a joystick or pad, cannot be followed.
db.binds.none: No ship keys found in the Bindings file yet.
db.binds.else: Also on a joystick or pad (those presses are not seen):
db.past.note: Your last fights and hunts, with what you pressed (up to 30), kept on this computer only. Starred ones always stay.
tip.db.past.list: Your last debriefs. Pick one to read its timeline.
tip.db.past.show: Show this report on the game for a while.
db.g.l.hold: hold (a bar, its length is the time)
db.g.limits: The game writes no distance, aim, speed or heat level, so none is shown. Boost, chaff and heat sink show only as your own key presses. Enemy health appears only where a scan showed it.
mode.pvp.name: PVP
mode.pvp.desc: Record your fights against other commanders and look at them again.

pvp.privacy: PVP mode makes one file for each fight with another commander, from what the game writes about you. It holds no keys and no mouse data, and no commander ID. It is saved on this computer only. You send it to the other commander yourself, if you want to.
pvp.on.d: Records each fight with another commander as a file. Off until you turn it on.
tip.pvp.on: Turn PVP mode on or off. When on, each fight with a commander is saved as a file on this computer.
pvp.shield: A shield going down ends a fight
pvp.shield.d: For fights that stop at the first shield down. Off: a fight ends at a death, a kill, a jump or after a calm.
tip.pvp.shield: End the fight when a shield goes down, yours or the other commander's (when scanned).
pvp.build: Put my ship's build in the file
pvp.build.d: The ship and its modules with their engineering, so you can compare builds. No ship name, no values.
tip.pvp.build: Add your ship's modules and engineering to the file. Turn off to keep your build to yourself.
tip.pvp.folder: Open the folder with your PVP files in Explorer.
pvp.where: Files: XXX_vs_YYY_fight_N.gravitas in %APPDATA%\com.gravitasmap.app\pvp\ (XXX is you, YYY the other commander, N the fight's number). Plain text you can open in any editor.
menu.pvp.wnote: The chip shows at the top while PVP mode is on. Move it in Edit HUD.
pvp.list.note: Your PVP fights, saved on this computer, newest first. Pick one to read its timeline.
pvp.next: To read your fight together with the other commander's, use the Compare tab.
tip.pvp.list: Your PVP fights. Pick one to read its timeline.
db.g.notproof: This is a record for learning, not proof: a file can be edited.
tip.pvp.tab.cmp: Put your fight and the other commander's side by side.
pvp.cmp.note: Load your fight files and the other commander's. GRAVITAS finds the fights that are the same fight, puts the two on one clock and shows them together. The files are only read here: nothing is sent anywhere.
tip.pvp.cmp.mine: Load all the PVP fights saved on this computer as yours.
tip.pvp.cmp.files: Pick one or more .gravitas files from your computer.
tip.pvp.cmp.clear: Forget the loaded files (nothing is deleted).
tip.pvp.cmp.list: The fights found in both sets of files. Pick one to read it.
pvp.cmp.nopair: No fight was found in both sets. Check that the files are from the same fight (the names and the times must match).
pvp.cmp.bad: {n} file(s) were not PVP fight files and were skipped.
pvp.cmp.nudge.d: If the two sides look out of step, move the other commander's side by hand (seconds).
tip.pvp.cmp.nudge: Shift the other commander's timeline to the left or right.
pvp.sync.death: Put on one clock by your death and their kill: that is one moment. The two PCs' clocks differed by {s} s.
pvp.sync.kill: Put on one clock by your kill and their death: that is one moment. The two PCs' clocks differed by {s} s.
pvp.sync.interdiction: Put on one clock by the interdiction both files wrote. The two PCs' clocks differed by {s} s.
pvp.sync.clock: No death, kill or interdiction to line the files up: the two PCs' clocks are used as they are. If the sides look out of step, move one by hand.

tip.dev.link: Get a one-time code (8 characters, valid for 2 minutes). Type it on gravitasmap.com in any browser and that browser shows and manages the same devices as this app.
tip.dev.linkcode: The one-time code. It works once and only for 2 minutes. Anyone who types it first gets the pairing, so keep it to yourself.

fb.title: Send feedback
fb.sub: Your message goes straight to the GRAVITAS developers. It is sent only when you press Send.
fb.kind.question: Question
tip.fb.kind: Tells us what kind of message this is.
fb.text: What would you like to tell us?
fb.text.ph: Example: when I open the Map page and press Show on the map, the window stays empty.
tip.fb.text: Write what happened or what you wish for. At most 4000 characters.
fb.shots.hint: Up to 3. You can also paste one with Ctrl+V.
tip.fb.add: Pick up to 3 pictures from this PC. They are made smaller before they are sent.
tip.fb.remove: Takes this screenshot out of the message.
tip.fb.cmdr: So we know who wrote. You can leave it empty.
fb.mail: E-mail, if you want a reply (optional)
tip.fb.mail: Only used to answer you. You can leave it empty.
tip.fb.diag: Adds a short text of counts (no names, no Journal lines) that helps us find the cause.
fb.also: Always sent with the message: the app version and your Windows version. Nothing else.
fb.sent: Thank you! Your message was sent.
fb.fail.empty: Please write a few words first.
fb.fail.offline: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
fb.fail.big: The screenshots are too large. Please remove one.
fb.fail.other: The message could not be sent: {err}
vis.empty.p: Your travels appear here once you have flown in the game. GRAVITAS reads your Journals on this PC. Nothing is sent anywhere.
tip.vis.fx: Switch off glow, blur, parallax and the intro animation. Faster on a slow PC. Key X.
vis.search.ph: Where did I sell Gold?  Station, system, goods
tip.vis.search: Search your visits by system, station or goods. Key /.
tip.vis.chip: {name}: show only the stops where you did this (click again to clear).
tip.vis.fit: Fit all visits of this page into the view. Key F.
tip.vis.tilt: Tilt the map to see the height of the stops. Key T.
tip.vis.panel: Show or hide the details panel. Key C.
tip.vis.u.all: The last 12 months in detail. Older history is shown as faint dust.
tip.vis.timeline: Your whole history, one bar per month. Drag the window to look back in time, drag its edges to resize it, click an older month to open it. Wheel to zoom the window.
vis.lod.ind: Every stop shown · {n} on this page
vis.lod.grp: Grouped in {c} ly cells · {g} groups for {n} stops
vis.toast.slow: Drawing is slow on this PC.
tip.vis.ses: Open this play session as the page.
vis.act.none: Only passed through. No docking or trade here.
tip.vis.show: Open this system in the GRAVITAS MAP.
tip.vis.copy: Copy the system name, to paste it into the game's galaxy map search.
tip.vis.summary: Back to the summary of the page. Key Esc.
vis.keep.h: Keep a travel history on this PC
tip.vis.keep: Switch the travel history on or off. It stays on this PC and is never sent anywhere.
vis.keep.off: The travel history is off. When it is on, GRAVITAS reads your Journals and keeps a list of the systems you visited and what you did there, on this PC only. You can forget it again at any time.
tip.vis.forget: Delete the kept travel history from this PC. Your game Journals are not touched.
vis.forget.ask: Forget everything? This cannot be undone.
tip.vis.last: Type how many of your newest visits to show. Leave it empty to show all. Enter applies it.
tip.vis.last.apply: Show only this many of your newest visits.
vis.last.bad: Please enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
prefs.autostart.d: Opens GRAVITAS in the tray when you sign in to Windows. The window stays hidden until you open it.
tip.prefs.autostart: Starts GRAVITAS by itself each time you sign in to Windows, in the tray.
prefs.autostart.fail: Windows did not allow this change.
prefs.mintray.d: The minimize button hides the window in the tray, by the clock. Off: it minimizes to the taskbar.
tip.prefs.mintray: Chooses where the window goes when you press minimize.
prefs.closetray: Keep running in the tray when closed
prefs.closetray.d: The close button hides the window and the game windows keep working. Off: closing quits GRAVITAS.
tip.prefs.closetray: Chooses whether the close button quits GRAVITAS or only hides its window.
prefs.data.note: Everything GRAVITAS keeps lives on this PC. The Journal folder belongs to the game and is only read.
tip.prefs.open: Opens this folder in Windows Explorer.
prefs.xfer.note: Save your settings to a file to move them to another PC, then load the file there. Phone pairing and values that belong to this PC are not included.
tip.prefs.export: Writes your settings into a file in your Documents folder and shows it.
tip.prefs.import: Reads a settings file made by GRAVITAS. Your current settings are kept as a copy first.
prefs.xfer.loaded: {n} settings loaded. Close GRAVITAS from the tray icon and open it again to apply them.
prefs.xfer.bad: That file is not a GRAVITAS settings file.
vis.loading.sub: Your travel history is built from the game's Journal files on this PC. The first time takes a moment.
tip.vis.backstop: Shows the stop you were looking at again.
tip.vis.u.year: One year per page. Older years open from the archive.
tip.vis.arch: An older period of your history, loaded from this PC. Only one old period is kept in memory at a time.
tip.vis.arch.x: Close the archive and go back to the last 12 months.
vis.arch.big: That period holds {n} stops. Please pick a shorter period.
vis.arch.err: Could not load {p} yet. Trying again.
vis.stat.detail: Showing the last 12 months in detail
vis.pg.alldetail: {n} stops in detail · older history as dust
vis.last.loaded: Only {max} stops are loaded. Pick an older period on the timeline to see more.
vis.sum.months: Added up from the monthly summaries. The top lists are approximate.
vis.ill: Spiral: illustration, not a star map
tip.vis.ill: The faint spiral behind the map is only decoration. Your stops, the route and the three landmarks (Sol, Colonia, Sagittarius A*) use real coordinates.
tip.w.front: Put this window in front of the others, where they overlap.
tip.w.back: Put this window behind the others, where they overlap.
